integrity: The all-order statement is proved analytically from the exact Lagrange-cardinal coefficients and a beta-integral summation. The packaged rational-arithmetic check is supplementary and is not used to infer the infinite statement. The source date is day-resolved from bibliographic metadata for the October 1988 publication.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the centered, equispaced, maximal-polynomial-exactness first-derivative stencil and deterministic componentwise bounded data perturbations. It does not cover stochastic RMS noise, floating-point weight-generation error, nonuniform or one-sided stencils, or higher derivative orders. Older differentiation-formula conditioning literature remains a terminology risk.
title: Harmonic-number noise law for maximal centered differences
